name: WordForm – Visual Form Builder
author: softcoy

sections.description:
WordForm is a visual WordPress form builder for contact forms, appointment bookings, quote requests, surveys and payment gateway integration. Start with a ready-made template or guided setup, customize your fields with drag and drop, and publish using a block or shortcode. No coding required.

Turn website enquiries into organized responses. Collect customer details, let visitors choose an appointment time, receive submission emails, and send form entries to Google Sheets. Build forms for service enquiries, customer feedback, event registrations and everyday business requests from your WordPress dashboard.

Choose a standard layout, divide a longer form into multiple steps, or guide visitors through up to five conversational questions with optional answer review. Preview your form on desktop, tablet and mobile before publishing.

Explore WordForm features | Read the WordForm setup guides

See how WordForm works

Watch the visual builder workflow, then follow the guides below to create and publish your own form. Tutorials may demonstrate additional options not included in this download; the included features and restrictions are described below.

Contact forms and visual form building

Build the form your visitors need without starting from code.

  • Drag fields into place or click to add them to your layout.
  • Start with an included form template or use Build with Guide for an editable starting form.
  • Create contact forms, lead enquiry forms, quote requests, customer feedback forms and registration forms.
  • Customize labels, placeholders, help text, required fields, validation messages and field widths.
  • Match submit button text and colors to your website.
  • Copy an existing form to reuse its layout.

Follow the visual form builder and template guide.

Conversational and multi-step forms

Make questions easier to follow with a form layout that suits your audience.

  • Create conversational forms with up to five question steps.
  • Choose whether to show a welcome screen, progress indicator, question numbers and final answer review.
  • Customize conversational navigation colors and hover colors.
  • Use page breaks to build standard multi-step forms with Previous and Next navigation.
  • Preview steps before publishing; editor previews do not accept real submissions.

Learn how to create conversational and multi-step forms.

Appointment booking calendars

Let visitors choose an available date and time directly on your website.

  • Create a calendar and set available dates, appointment duration and scheduling rules.
  • Connect the calendar to a Booking Calendar field in your form.
  • Set temporary reservation duration from 2 to 30 minutes while visitors complete their answers.
  • Show a countdown and let visitors reselect an available time if a temporary reservation expires.
  • View calendar activity with limited booking-detail access. Booking CSV export and customized booking emails are not included in this download.

Watch calendar setup through frontend preview:

Follow the appointment calendar and booking setup guide.

Payment gateway integration

Connect your form to Stripe or PayPal for orders, registrations, service requests and donations.

  • Add payment items, quantities, custom amounts, payment methods and a payment summary.
  • Configure your chosen gateway and review supported payment statuses.
  • Test your setup before accepting live transactions.

WordForm connects to third-party payment gateways; it is not a payment processor. Gateway accounts, credentials, fees and service terms apply.

Read the Stripe and PayPal setup guide.

Conditional fields, image uploads and spam protection

Ask relevant questions and collect useful details with familiar form controls.

  • Use basic conditional logic with one show/hide rule per form.
  • Collect an image attachment with an image upload field.
  • Add text, textarea, name, email, number, URL, address and hidden fields.
  • Use select lists, checkboxes, radio buttons, range controls, and date and time fields.
  • Add sections, HTML, terms and consent fields.
  • Choose numeric captcha, Google reCAPTCHA or hCaptcha to help reduce spam.

Image uploads are restricted to supported image formats and one file per upload field. Document uploads, multiple-file collection and advanced conditional rule groups are not included in this download. Consent fields help you collect consent; they do not by themselves ensure legal compliance.

See the form fields and customization guide.

Google Sheets and webhook connections

Move form responses into the tools you use for follow-up.

  • Connect a form to Google Sheets after configuring your Google credentials.
  • Match form fields to spreadsheet columns, including booking calendar values.
  • Send submission data to a Custom Webhook endpoint you configure.
  • Submit a test response and check the destination before using the connection with visitors.

Follow the Google Sheets and form integration guide.

Submissions and reporting

Keep your form responses organized inside WordPress.

  • Store submissions and review entries by form.
  • Receive submission email notifications using your site’s WordPress email configuration.
  • Explore limited submission analytics and country-level location reports.
  • Use reports alongside your entries to understand incoming enquiries.

Reporting access is restricted in this edition. Location reporting depends on available location data and may be unavailable for private or local network addresses.

Read the submission management and reporting guide.

Publish forms in posts and pages

Save your form, then add it to your content with the WordForm block or a shortcode. Use editor preview to check its appearance and navigation before publishing.

Watch two ways to add forms to WordPress posts and pages.

Explore more workflows

The features above describe this download. Some controls shown in screenshots, tutorials or documentation are previews or belong to other editions and are not included here.

Compare WordForm features and available plans, or follow the step-by-step WordForm documentation to find the right workflow for your website.

Watch more WordForm video tutorials on the SOFTCOY YouTube channel. For product news, follow SOFTCOY on Facebook.

Privacy and connected services

Google Sheets, payment gateways, external captcha services and Custom Webhooks require configuration and may send relevant form data to the selected provider when used. Review each provider’s terms and privacy policy before enabling a connection. See the integration setup guide.

If you explicitly subscribe to product emails, the entered email address, plugin choice and consent/version are sent to the SOFTCOY email subscription service. Confirmation is required before marketing emails begin; subscribing is not required to use WordForm. Read the SOFTCOY privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New and search for WordForm.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open WordForm and choose Add New to create a form.
  4. Start with a blank layout, an included template or Build with Guide.
  5. Customize the fields, save your form, and use Preview and Test to check it.
  6. Add the WordForm block to a post or page and select your saved form, or insert its shortcode.
  7. Publish the page and send a test submission to check your email and connected services.

For manual installation, upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/wordform/ and activate it from Plugins.
sections.faq:
How do I create a contact form without coding?

Open WordForm > Add New, choose an included template or Build with Guide, and customize your fields. Save the form and add it to a page with the WordForm block or shortcode. Follow the create your first form guide.

Can I build conversational forms?

Yes. Conversational mode supports up to five question steps in this download. Select the Form Name element to choose the display mode and configure the welcome screen, progress display and optional review summary. Use Standard Form mode for longer forms or standard multi-step layouts.

Can I split a form into multiple steps?

Yes. Use page breaks in a standard form to organize questions into steps with Previous and Next navigation. Conversational mode uses its own question-by-question flow instead of page breaks.

How do conditional form fields work?

A show/hide rule displays or hides a field based on an answer. This download includes one basic show/hide rule per form. Test both matching and non-matching answers before publishing. See the conditional field setup guide.

Can visitors book an appointment on my website?

Yes. Create a booking calendar, configure availability and time slots, then select that calendar in your form’s Booking Calendar field. Publish the form so visitors can choose an available appointment. Booking-detail access is limited in this download. Read the booking calendar guide.

How long is a selected appointment time reserved?

The default temporary reservation lasts 5 minutes. Under Bookings > Availability > Scheduling rules, set Temporary reservation duration from 2 to 30 minutes. If the countdown expires, visitors can select an available time again without losing their other answers. Confirmed bookings are not cancelled by this countdown.

Can I export bookings or send branded booking emails?

Booking CSV export and customized booking notification emails are not included in this download. See the booking workflow guide and compare available features before choosing a setup.

Which payment gateways can I connect?

Stripe and PayPal are included. You need your own gateway account and appropriate credentials; the provider’s fees and terms apply. Follow the payment gateway configuration guide and test before accepting live transactions.

How do I send WordPress form entries to Google Sheets?

Configure Google Sheets in WordForm > Integrations using the credentials and callback URL requested by the setup screen. Authorize your Google account, select the form and configured application, and create the connection. Submit a test entry and check the spreadsheet headings and values. Follow the Google Sheets connection guide.

Can visitors upload files with their forms?

This download supports one image per upload field in supported image formats. Document uploads and multiple-file collection are not included. See the form field guide for setup and available options.

Can I receive form submissions by email?

Yes. Enable submission email notifications and check the recipient settings. Delivery uses your WordPress site’s email configuration, so send a test submission before publishing. Customized booking and payment email workflows are not included here.

How can I reduce form spam?

Use the included numeric captcha or configure Google reCAPTCHA or hCaptcha. External captcha services require their own credentials and are subject to their provider’s terms.

Can I check how my form looks on mobile?

Yes. Use Preview and Test to check desktop, tablet and mobile views. Editor previews let you inspect embedded forms without accepting real submissions. Test the published page separately to confirm your theme’s final layout.

Can I change a form after publishing it?

Yes. Edit and save the form in WordForm. Its block and shortcode display the saved form. If your site uses caching, clear the relevant page cache before checking the changes.

Can I review submissions and location reports?

Yes. Review stored entries by form. Analytics and country-level Geo reporting have restricted access in this edition. Location data depends on the submission environment and may not be available for local or private network addresses.

Where can I find tutorials and help?

Start with the WordForm setup guides, watch WordForm tutorials on YouTube, or open WordForm > Support. The documentation covers multiple editions; check the feature comparison for availability.
sections.changelog:
4.1.5

  • Fixed Google Sheets field-to-column matching, including Booking Calendar and Country / Region fields, to keep submitted values under the correct headings.
  • Improved connection updates to preserve existing spreadsheet columns and append unmatched fields without shifting submission data.
  • Refined the booking calendar month and timezone layout and made Calendar Details more compact and responsive.
  • Improved booking reliability on cached pages with automatic security-token renewal and recovery.
  • Added calendar-specific temporary reservation duration and a visitor countdown, with clearer expiry guidance that preserves entered answers.
  • Added a booking export preview with direct access to premium, where daily and date-range CSV exports are available.
  • Improved booking date validation and responsive export controls.

4.1.4

  • Minor UI bug fix.

4.1.3

  • Minor UI bug fixes.

4.1.2

  • Fixed an issue that could prevent upgrading to the premium edition with a valid license key from the Go premium page.
  • Improved premium package download compatibility for site URLs, including WordPress installations in subdirectories.
  • Improved installation error messages to make upgrade problems easier to identify and resolve.

4.1.1

  • Improved form-specific submit button color controls so normal, hover, and text color pickers stay compact and readable in the builder sidebar.
  • Improved embedded WordForm post/page display by removing disabled post title and meta markup before frontend rendering, reducing first-load layout movement.
  • Improved release readiness for form embed styling and post/page display behavior.

4.1.0

  • Added conversational form mode so forms can guide visitors through one focused question step at a time.
  • Added conversational welcome screen controls, progress display, question numbering, Questions & Buttons Color, button hover color, navigation labels, and optional final answer review.
  • Improved conversational form behavior for placeholders, first-step Back button state, review summary display, final-step Submit placement when answer review is disabled, and responsive frontend spacing.
  • Added clearer builder guidance for standard, multi-step, and conversational form workflows.
  • Improved documentation and feature copy for conversational forms, guided building, templates, bookings, payments, conditional logic, and reporting.
  • Improved release readiness wording, WordPress compatibility notes, and public feature discovery.

4.0.0

  • Major release with expanded form building, booking, payment, reporting, and the premium edition upgrade-preview workflows.
  • Added and polished booking calendar workflows with availability, time slots, capacity protection, booking reports, and premium booking email previews.
  • Added dedicated Payments area with gateway configuration, supported payment reports, guided payment setup links, and locked premium previews for advanced gateway, report, and email workflows.
  • Added dashboard widget summaries, analytics reporting, Geo reporting previews, and clearer submission report navigation.
  • Added conditional logic improvements, conditional success message previews, conditional email previews, and clearer premium upgrade messaging.
  • Added Country / Region field support as a premium preview, with country/state-region workflows documented for premium.
  • Improved the Add New/Edit builder UI with better sticky toolbar behavior, panel scrolling, Build with Guide, form templates, copy form workflow, save feedback, and responsive preview polish.
  • Improved upload, consent, checkbox, rating, payment, booking, and multi-step frontend UI details.
  • Improved Settings, Bookings, Payments, Integrations, Support, Get premium, and wp-admin dashboard presentation.
  • Added updated WordPress.org screenshot set from polished WordForm admin screens.
  • Improved readme tags, FAQs, screenshot descriptions, and premium documentation links for clearer feature discovery.

3.0.1

  • Minor bug fixed.
  • Added Booking Calendar forms with local availability, time-slot holds, capacity protection, and starter booking-detail reporting.

3.0.0

  • Major release with refreshed WordForm admin screenshots and a clearer WordPress.org presentation.
  • Improved the visual builder experience with clearer drag-and-drop panels, responsive layout guidance, form templates, and live field option controls.
  • Expanded included workflows around multi-step forms, Date and Time fields, image upload controls, numeric captcha, Google reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Stripe, PayPal, Google Sheets, and Custom Webhook.
  • Added clearer the premium edition previews for premium fields, advanced payment options, integrations, reporting, connection logs, and support upgrades.
  • Improved Forms, Submissions, Settings, Integrations, Support, and Go premium admin pages so users can better understand included features and available upgrade paths.
  • Updated WordPress.org screenshot assets to full-page plugin admin views.

2.0.3

  • Added expanded form building with multi-step forms, Date and Time fields, hCaptcha, Google reCAPTCHA, image upload controls, Stripe, PayPal, Google Sheets, and Custom Webhook.
  • Added locked the premium edition previews for premium fields, advanced payments, integrations, reporting, and support surfaces.
  • Improved payment settings with guided Stripe and PayPal setup plus locked Square and Authorize.Net previews.
  • Improved date/time picker behavior, upload limits, captcha configuration, support diagnostics, and submission handling.
  • Improved database schema upgrades so new tables and columns are applied during plugin updates without reactivation.
  • Removed outdated tutorial video links from the readme.

2.0.2

  • Fixed minor Google reCAPTCHA bugs.

2.0.1

  • Fixed minor bugs.
  • Added more numeric captcha templates.

2.0.0

  • Updated the admin interface for easier form creation.
  • Added Range slider element.
  • Added Google reCAPTCHA element to protect forms.

1.2.1

  • Tested with WordPress 6.6.
  • Fixed minor bugs.

1.2.0

  • Improved browser compatibility for form submissions.
  • Fixed a form submission security issue.

1.1.0

  • Displayed latest user submission data first.
  • Fixed form delete behavior from the All Forms page.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added drag-and-drop form builder.
  • Added email notifications for submitted form data.
  • Added dashboard submission data management.
  • Added submit button styling controls.
  • Added custom validation messages.
  • Added block editor and shortcode embed support.
  • Added numeric captcha field.
